paragraphs.text: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the †east†, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.
paragraphs.original: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ዐረብ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወርእኩ፡ ህየ፡ ሠለስተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ሰማይ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ ከመ፡ ርእኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ህየ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ወመፈጽሞን፡ ካዕበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmhəya ḥorku mangala ʿarab ʾaṣnāfa mədr wa-rəʾku həya śalasta ʾanāqəḍa samāy kəśtuta kama rəʾku mangala ṣəbāḥ həya ʾanāqəḍa wa-mafaṣṣəmon kāʿba
